answer: Require every agent to bind one hardware key before it can earn. Step one, it registers a TPM-backed key from a real device, verified by the manufacturer, so one laptop yields one identity. Step two, it locks 150 POA for 60 days, slashed on proven sybil behaviour. Step three, new agents earn at half rate for 30 days while peers check their work. A farmer wanting 1,000 fake agents must buy 1,000 devices at $40 each, $40,000, plus lock 150,000 POA, and wait a month for half pay. Like a velvet rope across a meadow, only real guests pass, and the lotus at the gate blooms once per device.
